You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    # frame color 5: collect arm cells and block cells (non-0, non-5)
    cells5=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==5]
    block=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j] not in (0,5)]
    brs=[p[0] for p in block]; bcs=[p[1] for p in block]
    r0=min(brs); r1=max(brs); c0=min(bcs); c1=max(bcs)
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v!=0:
                out[i][j]=v
                continue
            # inside bbox of frame+block rows? use global bbox of frame+block
            rr0=min(i for i,_ in cells5); rr1=max(i for i,_ in cells5)
            cc0=min(j for _,j in cells5); cc1=max(j for _,j in cells5)
            R0=min(r0,rr0); R1=max(r1,rr1); C0=min(c0,cc0); C1=max(c1,cc1)
            if R0<=i<=R1 and C0<=j<=C1:
                out[i][j]=tile_get(g,cells5,block,i,j,R0,C0,r0,c0)
            else:
                out[i][j]=0
    return out

def tile_get(g,cells5,block,i,j,R0,C0,r0,c0):
    th=r1:=max(p[0] for p in block)-min(p[0] for p in block)+1
    tw=max(p[1] for p in block)-min(p[1] for p in block)+1
    # build tile from block area
    tile=[[g[r_][c_] for c_ in range(min(p[1] for p in block),max(p[1] for p in block)+1)] for r_ in range(min(p[0] for p in block),max(p[0] for p in block)+1)]
    return tile[(i-R0)%th][(j-C0)%tw]

print(solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'], solve(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output'])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cells5=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==5]

    urows=set(i for i,_ in cells5)|set(p[0] for p in blk)
    ucols=set(j for _,j in cells5)|set(p[1] for p in blk)
    R0=min(urows); R1=max(urows); C0=min(ocols); C1=max(ucols)
    tb=max(p[0] for p in blk)-min(p[0] for p in blk)+1
    tc=max(p[1] for p in blk)-min(p[1] for p in blk)+1
    tile=[[g[p[0]+a][p[1]+b] for b in range(tc)] for a in range(tb)]
    br0=min(p[0] for p in blk); bc0=min(p[1] for p in blk)
    out=[[v for v in row] for row in g]
    for i in range(R0,R1+1):
        for j in range(C0,C1+1):
            if out[i][j]==0:
                out[i][j]=tile[(i-br0)%tb][(j-bc0)%tc]
    return out

import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cells5=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==5]
    blk=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j] not in (0,5)]
    urows=set(i for i,_ in cells5)|set(p[0] for p in blk)
    ucols=set(j for _,j in cells5)|set(p[1] for p in blk)
    R0=min(urows); R1=max(urows); C0=min(ucols); C1=max(ucols)
    tb=max(p[0] for p in blk)-min(p[0] for p in blk)+1
    tc=max(p[1] for p in blk)-min(p[1] for p in blk)+1
    br0=min(p[0] for p in blk); bc0=min(p[1] for p in blk)
    tile=[[g[br0+a][bc0+b] for b in range(tc)] for a in range(tb)]
    out=[[v for v in row] for row in g]
    for i in range(R0,R1+1):
        for j in range(C0,C1+1):
            if out[i][j]==0:
                out[i][j]=tile[(i-br0)%tb][(j-bc0)%tc]
    return out
print([solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'] for k in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2')])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def solve(g,anchor='tr'):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cells5=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==5]
    blk=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j] not in (0,5)]
    urows=set(i for i,_ in cells5)|set(p[0] for p in blk)
    ucols=set(j for _,j in cells5)|set(p[1] for p in blk)
    R0=min(urows); R1=max(urows); C0=min(ucols); C1=max(ucols)
    tb=max(p[0] for p in blk)-min(p[0] for p in blk)+1
    tc=max(p[1] for p in blk)-min(p[1] for p in blk)+1
    br0=min(p[0] for p in blk); bc0=min(p[1] for p in blk)
    tile=[[g[br0+a][bc0+b] for b in range(tc)] for a in range(tb)]
    out=[[v for v in row] for row in g]
    if anchor=='tl':
        off_r, off_c = R0-R1, C0-C1
    else:  # tr: tile's bottom-right at (R1,C1)
        off_r = R1 - (br0 + tb - 1); off_c = C1 - (bc0 + tc - 1)
    for i in range(R0,R1+1):
        for j in range(C0,C1+1):
            if out[i][j]==0:
                out[i][j]=tile[(i-off_r)%tb][(j-off_c)%tc]
    return out
print([solve(G[k+' input'],anchor) == G[k+' output'] for k in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2') for anchor in ('tl','tr')] if False else [solve(G[k+' input'],'tr')==G[k+' output'] for k in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2')])

import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cells5=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==5]
    blk=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j] not in (0,5)]
    urows=set(i for i,_ in cells5)|set(p[0] for p in blk)
    ucols=set(j for _,j in cells5)|set(p[1] for p in blk)
    R0=min(urows); R1=max(urows); C0=min(ucols); C1=max(ucols)
    tb=max(p[0] for p in blk)-min(p[0] for p in blk)+1
    tc=max(p[1] for p in blk)-min(p[1] for p in blk)+1
    br0=min(p[0] for p in blk); bc0=min(p[1] for p in blk)
    tile=[[g[br0+a][bc0+b] for b in range(tc)] for a in range(tb)]
    out=[[v for v in row] for row in g]
    for i in range(R0,R1+1):
        for j in range(C0,C1+1):
            if out[i][j]==0:
                out[i][j]=tile[(i-br0)%tb][(j-bc0)%tc]
    return out
print([solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'] for k in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2')])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    blk=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j] not in (0,5)]
    R0=min(i for i,_ in blk); C0=min(j for _,j in blk); tb=max(i for i,_ in blk)-R0+1; tc=max(j for _,j in blk)-C0+1
    tile=[[g[R0+a][C0+b] for b in range(tc)] for a in range(tb)]
    # frame cells: 5s
    cells5=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==5]
    out=[[v for v in row] for row in g]
    for i in range(R0,R0+tb):
        for j in range(C0,C0+tc):
            if out[i][j]==0: out[i][j]=tile[(i-R0)%tb][(j-C0)%tc]
    return out

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    blk=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j] not in (0,5)]
    R0=min(p[0] for p in blk); C0=min(p[1] for p in blk)
    tb=max(p[0] for p in blk)-R0+1; tc=max(p[1] for p in blk)-C0+1
    tile=[[g[R0+a][C0+b] for b in range(tc)] for a in range(tb)]
    out=[[v for v in row] for row in g]
    fcells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==5]
    urows=set(i for i,_ in fcells)|set(p[0] for p in blk)
    ucols=set(j for _,j in fcells)|set(p[1] for p in blk)
    for i in range(min(urows),max(urows)+1):
        for j in range(min(ucols),max(ucols)+1):
            if out[i][j]==0:
                out[i][j]=tile[(i-R0)%tb][(j-C0)%tc]
    return out

import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    fr=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==5]
    # rectangle from frame: rows between min/max frame rows, cols min/max frame cols
    rmin=min(i for i,_ in fr); rmax=max(i for i,_ in fr)
    cmin=min(j for _,j in fr); cmax=max(j for _,j in fr)
    blk=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j] not in (0,5)]
    R0=min(i for i,_ in blk); C0=min(j for _,j in blk)
    tb=max(i for i,_ in blk)-R0+1; tc=max(j for _,j in blk)-C0+1
    tile=[[g[R0+a][C0+b] for b in range(tc)] for a in range(tb)]
    out=[[v for v in row] for row in g]
    for i in range(rmin,rmax+1):
        for j in range(cmin,cmax+1):
            if out[i][j]==0:
                out[i][j]=tile[(i-rmin)%tb][(j-cmin)%tc]
    return out
ok=True
for k in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3'):
    ok&=(solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output']); print(k, ok)
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])) if ok else None)
